unitTitle: On Top of the World - Episode 2: The Rescue
scanNote:
3-HIKOYa - 'ON TOP OF THE WORLD', 2-EPIZOD 'The Rescue' (112-bet). KOMIKS, 8 kadr.

Yuqorida chapda YaShIL yorliq: kasseta belgisi, 'Episode 2', 'The Rescue'. Sariq sarlavha 'On Top of the World'.

1-KADR: Qo'ngan samolyot ichida, dvigateldan tutun. David: 'Well, at least we've landed safely. I'm sure someone will come and rescue us.' Tony (radioga): 'Mayday! Mayday! ... It's no use - the radio isn't working.' Sandra: 'Yes, but there's a lot of smoke coming out of the engine! We'd better get out of here quickly!'
2-KADR: Muz ustida, orqada samolyot. Sandra: 'Brr! It's freezing cold out here!' Tony: 'We have to find a way to keep warm! Let's try to make a tent with some of our things ...'
3-KADR: 'GRRR!!!' - oq ayiq oyoqqa turgan, Sandra qo'rqib qaramoqda, David va Tony orqada narsalar bilan band. Sandra: 'Oh, no! A huge polar bear! Quick! Someone help me!'
4-KADR: 'BANG' - ayiq qochmoqda. Sandra: 'What's that noise? Oh, thank goodness! The polar bear is running away!'
5-KADR: Qor mototsiklida ikki odam (qalin jigarrang kiyim, ko'zoynak). Sandra: 'Thank you! How did you do that?' Sayyoh: 'We've got special 'noisemakers' ...'
6-KADR: Qor mototsikllari, samolyot, uch qahramon. Andy: 'Let me introduce myself. I'm Andy Wilson, and this is Ken Chapman. We're explorers. Are you all okay?' David: 'Yes, but our radio isn't working. How did you find us?' Andy: 'We saw the smoke, and we came to see what it was.'
7-8-KADR: Andy: 'We're on our way to the research station. Hop onto our snowmobiles quickly, before you freeze to death!' Sandra: 'How can we ever thank you enough? You've saved our lives! And now we've got THREE stories to tell - the glaciers, the crash landing and an escape from a terrifying polar bear!'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '112'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story. Episode 2: The Rescue.
exercises.explanationUz:
1-EPIZODNI ESLANG (110-bet):
Sandra, David va Tony Grenlandiya
ustida samolyotda uchayotganda
dvigatel to'xtadi. Tony muz ustiga
qo'nmoqchi.


2-EPIZOD TARJIMASI:

1) David: Hech bo'lmasa xavfsiz
   qo'ndik. Ishonchim komil, kimdir
   kelib bizni qutqaradi.
   Tony: Mayday! Mayday! ... Foydasi
   yo'q - radio ishlamayapti.
   Sandra: Ha, lekin dvigateldan
   ko'p tutun chiqyapti! Bu yerdan
   tezroq chiqqanimiz ma'qul!

2) Sandra: Brr! Bu yerda muzday
   sovuq!
   Tony: Isinish yo'lini topishimiz
   kerak! Narsalarimizdan chodir
   yasashga harakat qilaylik ...

3) GRRR!!!
   Sandra: Voy, yo'q! Ulkan oq ayiq!
   Tez! Kimdir yordam bering!

4) BANG!
   Sandra: Bu qanday shovqin? Voy,
   xudoga shukur! Oq ayiq qochib
   ketyapti!

5) Sandra: Rahmat! Buni qanday
   qildingiz?
   Sayyoh: Bizda maxsus 'shovqin
   chiqargichlar' bor ...

6) Andy: O'zimni tanishtiray. Men
   Andy Wilson, bu esa Ken Chapman.
   Biz sayyohlarmiz. Hammangiz
   yaxshimisiz?
   David: Ha, lekin radiomiz
   ishlamayapti. Bizni qanday
   topdingiz?
   Andy: Tutunni ko'rdik va bu nima
   ekanini ko'rgani keldik.

7-8) Andy: Biz tadqiqot stansiyasiga
   ketyapmiz. Muzlab o'lishdan oldin
   tezroq qor mototsikllarimizga
   o'tiring!
   Sandra: Sizga qanday yetarli
   rahmat aytamiz? Hayotimizni
   saqlab qoldingiz! Endi bizda
   UChTA hikoya bor - muzliklar,
   avariyali qo'nish va dahshatli oq
   ayiqdan qutulish!


⚠ 'A RESCUE':

  = qutqaruv.
  ⚠ 'to rescue' = qutqarmoq.


⚠ 'AT LEAST':

  = hech bo'lmasa.


⚠ "IT'S NO USE":

  = foydasi yo'q.


⚠ 'SMOKE':

  = tutun.


⚠ 'TO KEEP WARM':

  = isinib turmoq.


⚠ 'A TENT':

  = chodir.


⚠ 'THANK GOODNESS!':

  = Xudoga shukur!


⚠ 'TO RUN AWAY':

  = qochib ketmoq.


⚠ 'A NOISEMAKER':

  = shovqin chiqargich (hayvonlarni
  qo'rqitish uchun).


⚠ 'LET ME INTRODUCE MYSELF':

  = O'zimni tanishtiray.


⚠ 'AN EXPLORER':

  = sayyoh, kashfiyotchi.


⚠ 'TO HOP ONTO':

  = sakrab minmoq.


⚠ 'A SNOWMOBILE':

  = qor mototsikli.


⚠ 'TO FREEZE TO DEATH':

  = muzlab o'lmoq.


⚠ 'HOW CAN WE EVER THANK YOU
ENOUGH?':

  = Sizga qanday yetarli rahmat
  aytamiz? (katta minnatdorlik)


⚠ 'A CRASH LANDING':

  = avariyali qo'nish.


⚠ 'TERRIFYING':

  = dahshatli.

exercises.instructionEn: Check your understanding of the episode.

items.textEn: 1 Why doesn't the Mayday call work?
2 Why do they have to get out of the plane quickly?
items.uz: 2 Nega ular samolyotdan tez chiqishi kerak?
options: Because there's a lot of smoke coming out of the engine.
items.answer: Because there's a lot of smoke coming out of the engine.

items.textEn: 3 What does Tony suggest to keep warm?
items.uz: 3 Tony isinish uchun nima taklif qiladi?
options: making a tent with some of their things
items.answer: making a tent with some of their things
items.whyUz: ⚠ "Let's try to make a tent with some of our things".

items.textEn: 4 What frightens the polar bear away?
options: a loud bang from a noisemaker
items.answer: a loud bang from a noisemaker

items.textEn: 6 How did the explorers find them?
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'We saw the smoke, and we came to see what it was.'

items.textEn: 7 How many stories will Sandra and David have to tell?
items.uz: 7 Sandra va Davidda nechta hikoya bo'ladi?
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'three stories - the glaciers, the crash landing and an escape from a polar bear'.
